literal: Mother's hunger he who sees even if, let him not do noble ones condemning action.
translation: Even if one has to see one's own mother starving, one must not do deeds that the noble condemn.
modern: பெற்ற தாயின் பசியைக் காண நேர்ந்தாலும், சான்றோர்கள் பழிக்கும் தீய செயல்களை ஒருவன் செய்யக்கூடாது.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the absolute necessity of purity in action, regardless of the circumstances. The most extreme and emotionally compelling hardship one can face is seeing one's own mother suffer from hunger. Even in such a desperate situation, the text insists that one must not resort to actions condemned by the noble. The strong negative injunction 'செய்யற்க' leaves no room for exceptions, placing moral integrity above even the most fundamental human attachments.
